about.text: A spiced variant of ayib, the Ethiopian cottage-type cheese, made in the northwest of Ethiopia. Ayib is mixed with local spices such as rue and basil and left to ferment spontaneously for about 15 to 20 days; it is said to keep longer than ordinary ayib.
